_readme: Published PRODUCTION COST (money spent before revenue), million ₫ per ha, per crop key (same keys as pipeline/profits.json). cost = the figure, or the midpoint of range [low, high]; range is null for a single number. unit 'crop' = per crop, 'year' = per year (shrimp: one season a year). year = harvest year (winter–spring 2023–24 = 2024). kind: government | cooperative | university | news | farmer. method: 'stated' (page states the cost), 'revenue-minus-profit' (yield × price, or stated revenue, minus stated profit; arithmetic in calc), 'unit-cost-x-yield' (giá thành ₫/kg × yield). bound: 'upper' or 'lower' when the page says 'over'/'under' so the computed cost is a bound, not a value. covers: what the cost includes when it is known (some surveys leave out land preparation, machinery or harvest, or include family labour); none of these figures includes land rent unless covers says so. 1 công taken as 1,000 m² unless the page states its size. Quotes are Vietnamese as printed (the Mỹ Xuyên PDF uses a legacy font; its quote is transcribed from the decoded text). Checked 2026-11-14.

figures.place: Vinacam cooperative, Kiên Giang (low-emission trial, ĐS1)
figures.calc: stated revenue 82.2 M/ha − stated profit 55.5 M/ha = 26.7 M/ha (yield 10.3 t/ha fresh paddy)
figures.covers: not stated; a trial field, profit 6.7 M above the control field

source.title: VOV (28 Mar 2025), Kiên Giang thí điểm canh tác lúa giảm phát thải, lợi nhuận 55,5 triệu đồng/ha

figures.place: Long Phú district, Sóc Trăng
figures.calc: district yield 6.5 t/ha × ordinary-rice price 8,700–10,000 ₫/kg = 56.6–65.0 M; minus district profit 30–50 M. Midpoint 6.5 × 9,350 = 60.8 − 40 = 20.8; ends paired low price/low profit 56.6 − 30 = 26.6 and high price/high profit 65.0 − 50 = 15
figures.covers: not stated. Yield and profit from the district agriculture office (Lâm Văn Vũ); prices are the reporter's, so the pairing is an assumption

figures.calc: 6.5 t/ha × 10,800 ₫/kg = 70.2 M − profit 49 M ('nearly 49') = 21.2 M. Cross-check: the same department says model cost is 'over 5.3 M/ha, more than 20%' below fields outside the model: 5.3 / 0.2 ≈ 26.5 outside, 26.5 − 5.3 = 21.2 inside

figures.calc: model cost 21.2 M (from 70.2 M − 49 M) + stated gap 5.3 M = 26.5 M; consistent with the gap being '>20%' (5.3 / 26.5 = 20%)
figures.covers: not stated; this is the usual-practice cost, so better for an ordinary farm than the model figure

source.title: Thương hiệu và Công luận, citing VOV (10 Sep 2024), Tin vui trồng lúa theo mô hình thí điểm 1 triệu ha, nông dân thu lời gần 50 triệu/ha

UNIT DOUBT: the paper labels it 'per 1,000 m²', but its shrimp yield (558 kg) and revenue only make sense per ha for extensive tiger shrimp (558 kg/ha × 118,220 ₫/kg ≈ 66 M/ha), so the figure is taken as per ha. Read per 1,000 m² it would be 261 M/ha, which is not plausible

why_not.vi: Không tính vào tổng: số này là chi phí cả mô hình tôm – lúa, gồm cả vụ lúa.
why_not.en: Not used in the totals: it is the cost of the whole rice–shrimp system, rice included.

figures.calc: per công: 3–4 t × 4,000 ₫/kg = 12–16 M revenue; profit 5–10 M. Pairing low with low and high with high: 12 − 5 = 7 and 16 − 10 = 6 M per công; midpoint 14 − 7.5 = 6.5 M per công × 10 = 65 M/ha (60–70). Công taken as 1,000 m²; a 1,296 m² công would give about 50 M/ha
figures.covers: not stated
